say:1:1232002001:1.text: My name is Penny, and Pearl is my family name. We've been in the pearl business for generations, handling everything from trading to buying pearls.
say:1:1232002001:1.source_cn: 珀尔是我的姓氏，我们珀尔家族世世代代都在做水纹珍珠的生...

say:2:1232002002:1.text: Please come by if you are interested in Moonlit Pearls!
say:2:1232002002:1.source_cn: 如果你对水纹珍珠感兴趣，一定要来我这里逛逛哟。
